description.value: The Evelyne Saller Centre is a City of Vancouver community centre located in the Downtown Eastside neighbourhood at 404 Alexander Street. Operated by Vancouver Parks, Recreation and Culture, it serves as a community hub for the surrounding area. A touring cyclist passing through the DTES would find it a publicly accessible municipal facility in a central urban location.
